article.headline: UIC blows out Saint Francis (IL) 96-47 behind Mekhi Lowery's 20 points
article.description: — UIC opened its season Monday with a 96-47 victory over Saint Francis (IL), led by Mekhi Lowery’s 20 points.
article.linkText: UIC blows out Saint Francis (IL) 96-47 behind Mekhi Lowery's 20 points

event.description: St. Francis (IL) Fighting Saints @ UIC Flames

keywords: St. Francis (IL) Fighting Saints @ UIC Flames
article.story: CHICAGO -- — UIC opened its season Monday with a 96-47 victory over Saint Francis (IL), led by Mekhi Lowery’s 20 points. Lowery added seven rebounds and four steals for the Flames. Rashund Washington Jr. scored 15 points while going 3 for 5 from the field and 9 for 12 from the free-throw line. Jayce Nathaniel went 5 for 7 from the field to finish with 13 points and added 10 rebounds. Bryce Tillery finished with 12 points and two steals for the Fighting Saints. Saint Francis (IL) also got 12 points from Nick Niego. Tavariyuan Williams finished with nine points and two blocks. UIC took the lead for good with 19:33 left in the first half. The score was 51-31 at halftime, with Lowery scoring 16 points. UIC extended its lead to 96-44 during the second half, fueled by a 19-2 scoring run. Ahmad Henderson II scored a team-high 10 points in the second half as UIC closed out the win. Up next UIC plays Robert Morris at home Friday, and Saint Francis (IL) visits Fordham on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
